outcome: See temperature, humidity and the air you breathe.

views.title: Climate
views.condition: Provide climate inputs to Ramka, or with Ramka 0.17.0 or later leave them to the home's shared inputs (home_inputs); on the Ramka settings dashboard pick up to twenty widgets (temperature, air quality, custom or empty), in any order. With thresholds: climate-air and the shared inputs, each room's comfort range comes from climate-air's helpers.
views.layout: Ramka landscape layout: 1024–1280 × 720–800 CSS px; phone/portrait dashboard not claimed.

views.title: Air quality
views.condition: Provide air inputs (or, with Ramka 0.17.0 or later, the home's shared inputs) and compatible air-quality readings to Ramka; each reading and its limits can be changed on the Ramka settings dashboard. With thresholds: climate-air in Ramka 0.17.0 or later, those limits are climate-air's helpers.
views.layout: Ramka landscape layout: 1024–1280 × 720–800 CSS px; phone/portrait dashboard not claimed.

setup: Pair Tapo sensors to their hub and set up the Home Assistant integration.
For air measurements, add the optional Ruuvi Air and a supported Bluetooth path.
Map the sensor entities; configure Ramka climate or air inputs if you want these pages.
